 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 49.6 W Ishan Sood to Hadayatullah Khan, out Bowled!! Clean bowled. India win by 70 runs . That was a fuller ball, on the sticks, Hadayatullah Khan backs away and misses the slap. The ball slammed into the sticks. Ishan Sood finishes with a four-fer. That was speared in from the speedster to end the game. Hadayatullah Khan b Ishan Sood 0(3) 49.5 Ishan Sood to Hadayatullah Khan, no run, from round the wicket, outside off, Hadayatullah Khan looks to drive it and misses 49.4 Ishan Sood to Hadayatullah Khan, no run, angled across, fuller ball, Hadayatullah Khan looks to drive it and misses 49.3 W Ishan Sood to Muhammad Saad, out Caught by Arjun Rajput!! Low full toss, Muhammad Saad heaves it across the line and finds the man at deep mid. The fielder dived to his right and took it. That was not a great ball and he heaved it away. But sadly failed to clear the ropes. Muhammad Saad c Arjun Rajput b Ishan Sood 3(5) 49.2 Ishan Sood to Naseem Khan, 1 run, very full, played down to long-on for a single as he got it off the cue-end of the bat 49.1 Ishan Sood to Muhammad Saad, 1 run, very full, angled in, jammed down to long-on for a single 49.1 Ishan Sood to Muhammad Saad, no ball , that was taken on the on-side but that was deemed as no-ball. The third umpire had a look and siganalled it as a no-ball 47.6 Ishan Sood to Naseem Khan, 1 run, very full, angled in, jammed down to long-on 47.5 Ishan Sood to Naseem Khan, no run, very full, angled in, Naseem Khan jams that down by getting the bat down in time 47.4 W Ishan Sood to Ahmed Khudadad, out Bowled!! Splendid inswinging yorker! That was bowled from wide of the crease, angled it in, Ahmed Khudadad walked across to play that and played all over it to miss it. The ball hit the leg pole and ricocheted down to the fine leg fence. It seemed it had gone off the edge to the fence but that the Indians found out that the woodwork was disturbed. Ahmed Khudadad b Ishan Sood 74(74) [4s-6 6s-3] 47.3 Ishan Sood to Muhammad Saad, 1 run, jams the ball down into the on-side for a single 47.2 W Ishan Sood to Noorullah Ayobi, out Caught&Bowled!! Taken by the bowler. Low full toss, angled in, Noorullah Ayobi looks to whip it and gets a big leading edge. The bowler runs back and takes it. Easy take. Ishan Sood was expensive in the last over but has gotten his revenge now. Noorullah Ayobi c and b Ishan Sood 39(25) [4s-1 6s-4] 47.1 Ishan Sood to Ahmed Khudadad, 1 run, slower one, Ahmed Khudadad heaves it down to deep mid for a single 45.6 4 Ishan Sood to Ahmed Khudadad, FOUR , very full, outside off, Ahmed Khudadad jams the ball down and squeezes it fine for a four. Plenty still needed but UAE going down fighting. 20 runs off the over 45.5 6 Ishan Sood to Ahmed Khudadad, SIX , slower one, angled in, Ahmed Khudadad got under it and smoked it over deep mid for a sixer 45.4 Ishan Sood to Ahmed Khudadad, leg byes, 2 runs, angled down leg, Ahmed Khudadad walks across and looks to clip it. The ball goes off the pads for a brace. There was an appeal but the umpire turned it down 45.3 Ishan Sood to Noorullah Ayobi, 1 run, pats the ball down into the off-side for a single 45.2 6 Ishan Sood to Noorullah Ayobi, SIX , on a length, Noorullah Ayobi gets under the ball and launches it over long-on. That was put away with elan. He got a good chunk of that 45.1 Ishan Sood to Ahmed Khudadad, 1 run, slower one, outside off, Ahmed Khudadad stabs it down into the off-side for a single 6.6 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, defended off the front foot to the off-side 6.5 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, 2 runs, there goes another chance. This was the hardest of them all. Misbah forces the drive back to the bowler. The ball lobs over the bowler's reach on the right and rolls towards the fence. Ishan tries to reach in his followthrough and fails to get a hand to it 6.4 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, Ishan has dropped a simple return catch. His teammates cannot believe it. Bowls it on a good length and gets it to hold on the surface. Misbah pushes with hard hands and balloons it to the left of Ishan. Poor from the bowler 6.3 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, Misbah mistimes the push to the on-side 6.2 4 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, FOUR , back of a length delivery outside off, Ayaan Misbah stands tall and punches it off the back foot through the cover region. Mid-off dives, but can't stop it 6.1 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, pushed to the off-side 4.6 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, short delivery outside off, Misbah stands tall and punches it to mid-off 4.5 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, defended off the back foot to covers 4.4 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, 1 run, just a fraction short on fourth stump line. Zainullah gets a thick outside edge down to third man region 4.3 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, no run, this time Ishan gets it to move away from the left-hander. Was pitched in the same line. Zainullah plays inside the line of the ball and gets beaten on the outside edge 4.2 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, no run, that was so close to knock the off-stump. Angles it into the left-hander. Rehmani gets forward to drive and leaves a big gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and misses the off-stump by a whisker 4.1 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, no run, back of a length delivery from round the wicket. Zainullah blocks it back to Ishan 2.6 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, solid defence to a good length delivery outside off 2.5 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, width on offer from Ishan. Misbah taps it to the off-side 2.4 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, defended solidly back to Ishan 2.3 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, 1 run, good length delivery outside off, Zainullah Rehmani drops it to covers for a run 2.2 4 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, leg byes, FOUR , Ishan continues to bowl it down the leg-side. This time Rehmani fails to get bat on the ball but races away for four of the pads. Fine leg fielder was wide and couldn't get across 2.1 4 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, FOUR , poor delivery asking to be punished. Zainullah Rehmani gets little tickle on the delivery down the leg-side. The ball races away fine for four 0.6 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, much better line and length from Ishan. Misbah covers the stumps and defends the good length delivery back to Ishan 0.5 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, width on offer from Ishan. Misbah can't connect the cut properly. Finds point 0.4 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, no run, good length delivery outside off, Misbah mistimes the push to the off-side 0.3 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, leg byes, 1 run, poor shout for LBW from Ishan. This was pitching well outside leg-stump and he decides to go up for an appeal. Rehmani misses the tuck and the ball rolls to square leg of the pads 0.2 Ishan Sood to Zainullah Rehmani, no run, angled across the left-hander. Defended off the front foot to covers 0.1 Ishan Sood to Ayaan Misbah, 1 run, Ishan starts with a length delivery on the pads.
